testsuite.name: com.geoknoesis.trustweave.saas.server.migration.FlywayMigrationTest

testcase.name: the migration set applies cleanly to an empty database()
recovery age migration preserves existing timestamps and supports old inserts()
the entity scan finds tables, so the derived guard is not vacuously empty()
the set is idempotent when re-applied()
every entity table exists after migrating()
